intervals.label: PETRA data taking
intervals.locator: DESY backgrounder "The discovery of the gluon"; end from Bethke & Wagner (2022), Table 1
intervals.note: Start = January 1979 data-taking (the detector was moved into the beam in October 1978); end = the 3 November 1986 final shutdown of PETRA and its experiments.
intervals.quote: Data-taking started in January 1979 by the detectors MARK J, PLUTO and TASSO.

intervals.label: PETRA shut down; experiment ended
intervals.note: All PETRA experiments ended with the final shutdown of PETRA as a collider.
intervals.quote: final shutdown of PETRA and experiments

summary.plain: The international team that built and ran the TASSO detector at DESY's PETRA collider. Centred on DESY with groups from German and British universities, the Rutherford Laboratory, the Weizmann Institute and the University of Wisconsin.
summary.technical: TASSO collaboration at PETRA: DESY with members from the German universities of Aachen, Bonn and Hamburg, Imperial College, Oxford University, the Rutherford Laboratory, the Weizmann Institute and the University of Wisconsin (as described for 1979); leaders included B. Wiik and G. Wolf. 1995 EPS HEPP Prize to P. Söding, B. Wiik, G. Wolf and S. L. Wu for the three-jet evidence.
